name: How To Raise A Child
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to diligently teach and guide their children in the ways of the LORD, as Abraham exemplified by commanding his household to follow God's justice and judgment. This training involves consistent instruction throughout daily life and loving discipline, including the use of correction to remove folly from a child's heart. The promise of such faithful upbringing is that a child, once trained in the right path, will remain steadfast in it throughout life.
